items.title: Add RLS/IDOR regression tests for endpoints migrated in PR #421
evidence: PR #421 migrated 13 endpoints (market_pricing, notification_preferences, reports) to *_rls with zero test files in the diff.
reports.rs gained a new cross-tenant IDOR guard (403 when organization_id != tenant_id and not super-admin) with no test covering the branch.
Issue #160 lists 'Add RLS tests for migrated endpoints' as required work for these exact modules.
Issue #375: RLS penetration suite ran broken and is title-gated, so RLS regressions are not reliably caught on main.

items.title: Verify caddy register_route idempotency on staging + watch infra/caddy.rs churn
evidence: caddy.rs is the top churn file this run (~654 lines across #431 and same-day hardening #433).

PR #431 leaves 3 unchecked post-merge verification items: CI cargo test --workspace pass, a staging open->close->re-open one-route-per-host smoke, and confirmation that duplicate-sweep drift-warn events stop after a deploy cycle.

not promoted: the open items are a manual staging smoke (needs a real Caddy admin) and dashboard observation, not an automatable failing-on-main test; the file's logic is already covered by 11 passing inline unit tests.

items.title: Verify async-storage v3 migration follow-up (PR #395 unchecked box)
